limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on test was completed.
Ratings and review samples skew toward small organizations.
The most useful criticisms concern advanced workflows, not simple forms.
The pricing page showed European regional prices during research, while the help center lists a different U.S. Pro price.

sources.name: Reddit discussion about why Tally succeeds

claims.statement: Tally launched on Product Hunt on March 8, 2021.
Tally offers unlimited forms and submissions on Free within its fair-use policy, including payments, signatures, files, logic, calculations, and common integrations.
The pricing page showed Pro at €20 monthly and Business at €65 during European research. Tally's help center separately lists Pro at $29 in U.S. pricing, so buyers should check their local page.
Tally cites 50,000 monthly submissions, 100GB of monthly uploads or 500GB total storage, and 50,000 monthly notifications as examples of extensive use that can require a custom plan.
A clean document-like editor, generous free use, and useful integrations are repeated positive themes.
Advanced logic and deep customization become more manual or limited as forms get more complex.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The document-like editor and direct free plan make first use unusually simple.
scoreRationale.product: Tally handles a broad set of normal form jobs well, but complex logic and heavy customization expose the product's limits.
scoreRationale.support: G2 and Product Hunt contain repeated praise for helpful support, but this review did not test support directly.
scoreRationale.billing: The free plan is a major part of the value. Users should still check fair-use limits before building a business-critical process.
scoreRationale.overall: Tally is the rare form builder that feels lighter than its category while still doing enough for most small teams.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Reviews are unusually positive across the major platforms.
No new hands-on test was completed.
Complex enterprise requirements were not independently tested.
